Course Registration for Newly Admitted Students

Newly admitted students register for classes during Welcome Trojans orientation. New students should check their USC email address for an invitation to sign up for orientation or visit the Orientation website for more information. Students receive an invitation once they have committed to enroll at USC.

Newly admitted graduate students are assigned a default date of June 2 for the fall semester but should contact their academic department for more information about any orientation events they may offer.

Students may change their summer schedule via Web Registration . Schedule changes can be made according to the established deadlines on the Schedule of Classes for the respective course and session. For specific deadline dates, visit the “Classes Offered” section and click on the “Calendar” icon next to the course(s).
Last Day for Registration and Adding Classes
Please locate the course in the Schedule of Classes and click on the “Calendar” icon to view the registration deadlines.

Registration in the summer session does not ensure the privilege of registering for fall semester courses. Entering students who will register for fall must either enroll formally in the university or obtain permission from the Office of Admission.
